factionTraits.name: Martial Ka'tah
factionTraits.description:
At the start of your Command phase, friendly ^^**Adeptus Custodes**^^ units with this ability are **readied**. While a friendly unit is **readied**, you can select one of the **ka-tah abilities** for that unit to use. If you do, that unit is no longer **readied**.

Each **ka-tah ability** will tell you when that **ka-tah ability** can be used and the effects that **ka-tah ability** has on the unit using it.

factionTraits.name: Aegis of the Emperor
factionTraits.description: Friendly ^^**Adeptus Custodes**^^ units with this ability have Feel No Pain 5+ against **mortal wounds**.

factionTraits.name: Aquila Commander
factionTraits.description: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your ^^**Warlord**^^, gain 1CP.

factionTraits.name: Daughters of the Abyss
factionTraits.description:
- Friendly ^^**Anathema Psykana**^^ units with this ability have **Feel No Pain 3+** against **psychic attacks**.
- Friendly ^^**Anathema Psykana**^^ units with this ability have the following ability:
Psychic Null (Aura): Friendly ^^**Adeptus Custodes**^^ units within 6" of this unit have Feel No Pain 5+ against **psychic attacks**.

characteristics.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly **readied** unit is **selected to move**.
characteristics.effect: When your unit makes a **normal/advance/fall-back move**, your unit can move through all types of model.

Until the end of the turn:
- Being **engaged/battle-shocked** does not prevent your unit from being **eligible to start an action**.
- Starting an **action** does not prevent your unit from being **eligible to shoot**.
Your unit's melee attacks that target an enemy unit (excluding ^^**Monster/Vehicle**^^ units) can re-roll **hit rolls" of 1.
Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to **hit rolls**.

characteristics.when: Fight phase, when a friendly **readied** unit is **selected to fight**.
characteristics.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

characteristics.when: Your Shooting phase, when a **readied** unit is **selected to shoot**.
characteristics.effect:
Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit's:
- BS
- **Hit rolls** and **wound rolls**.

characteristics.description: This unit has Fights First.

- While this unit is below starting strength, this unit's attacks have +1 to **hit rolls**.
- While this unit is below half-strength, this unit's attacks have +1 to **wound rolls**.
This model can be attached to the following units: PROSECUTORS, VIGILATORS, WITCHSEEKERS
This unit's melee attacks that target a unit with a T greater than this unit's T have +1 to **wound rolls**.

This model can be attached to the following units: CUSTODIAN GUARD, CUSTODIAN GUARD WITH ADRASITE AND PYRITHITE SPEARS, CUSTODIAN WARDENS, SAGITTARUM CUSTODIANS

At the start of the first battle round, select one enemy unit to be this model's **mark**.
-This model's attacks that target this model's **mark** have +1 to **wound rolls**.
- Each time this model's **mark** is destroyed, select one enemy unit to be this model's **mark**.

This unit can:
- Re-roll **advance rolls**.
- Re-roll **charge rolls**.

This unit's attacks have [**SUSTAINED HITS 1: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE] if any of the following apply:
- This unit is within range of an objective.
- The target of those attacks is within range of an objective.
Attacks that target this unit have -1AP.

This model can be attached to the following units:
- Prosecutors
- Vigilators
- Witchseekers

- This unit has +2" M.
- This unit can re-roll **advance rolls** and **charge rolls**.

When an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS/VEHICLES) **engaged** with this unit makes a **fall-back move**, that enemy unit must use the **desperate escape mode**. If that enemy unit is **battle-shocked**, -1 from those **hazard rolls**.

In your Shooting phase, you can select one **visible** enemy unit within 18" of this unit. That unit is **detected**.
- While a unit is **detected**, that unit has +3" **detection range**.
This model can be attached to the following units: CUSTODIAN GUARD, CUSTODIAN GUARD WITH ADRASITE AND PYRITHITE SPEARS, CUSTODIAN WARDENS, SAGITTARUM CUSTODIANS

(Once per battle, per unit)
In your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if a model in this unit lost a wound as a result of those attacks, this unit can make a **surge move** of up to D6+2"
This model can be attached to the following units: ALLARUS CUSTODIANS, AQUILON CUSTODIANS

(Once per battle, per unit)
In your Movement phase, if this unit is **unengaged** and has not been **selected to move** this phase, you can use this ability. If you do, place this unit in **strategic reserves** and this unit must make an **ingress move** this phase.
This model can be attached to the following units: AGAMATUS CUSTODIANS, VERTUS PRAETORS

(Once per battle, per unit)
At the end of the Fight phase, if this unit was **eligible to fight** this phase:
- If this unit is **unengaged**, this unit can make a **normal move**.
- Or: if this unit is **engaged**, this unit can make a **fall-back move**.

This model can be attached to the following units: ALLARUS CUSTODIANS, AQUILON TERMINATORS WITH SOLARITE POWER GAUNTLETS, AQUILON TERMINATORS WITH SOLARITE POWER TALONS, CUSTODIAN GUARD SODALITY, CUSTODIAN GUARD SODALITY WITH ADRASITE SPEARS, CUSTODIAN GUARD SODALITY WITH PYRITHITE SPEARS, CUSTODIAN WARDENS, SAGITTARUM CUSTODIANS SODALITY, SENTINEL GUARD SODALITY

- Re-roll hit rolls of 1
- Re-roll wound rolls of 1

At the start of any phase, you can select one of the following to take effect until the end of the phase:
- This model’s Watcher’s Axe weapon has +3 A.
- This model has 3+ InSv.

Attacks that target this unit have -1 AP.

(Once per battle, per unit)
After making a hit roll, wound roll or save roll for this model, you can change the result to an unmodified 6.

(Once per battle, per unit)
At the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6:
- On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged and with 3 wounds remaining
In your Movement phase, when this unit ends a **normal move**, units embarked within this unit can make an **assault disembark move**.

characteristics.description:

- Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

This unit has a 4+ **InSv** against ranged attacks.

In your Movement phase, when this unit ends an **advance move**, units embarked within this unit can make a **shock disembark move**.

This unit has a 4+ **InSv** against ranged attacks.

In your Movement phase, when a friendly ^^**Adeptus Custodes**^^ unit is selected to make a **tactical disembark move** from this unit, if that unit is then selected to make an **advance move**, that **advance move** does not prevent that unit from being **eligible to declare a charge**.

- Roll one D6 for each model in that enemy unit:
- On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
This model can be attached to the following units: ^^**Custodian Guard, Custodian Wardens**^^

- This unit is within range of an objective.
- The target of those attacks is within range of an objective.

- This unit has +1 OC.
- This unit can ignore modifiers to this unit's Ld.
